note: Step 1's entry without its expected_diagnostic_sha256. A run takes every issue in its window and refs, so only the digest refuses a period that appears in or leaves it; the entry is refused at load.
fails_if: the curation compiler accepts a `missing_coding_period` acknowledgement without `expected_diagnostic_sha256` instead of refusing it with `acknowledge_run_digest_missing` at its entry, so a run silently acknowledges whatever issues fall in its window
